Claude local compatibility experimental integration

This build embeds the claude-local core from BigPizzaV3/ClaudeMom.
Upstream project: https://github.com/BigPizzaV3/ClaudeMom
Core license: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only.
The full license is supplied as LICENSE-claude-local.txt.
Local modifications are documented in TUZI-PATCHES.md.

The candidate workflow publishes a matching source snapshot as the
claude-local-corresponding-source artifact, identified by its Git revision.
That snapshot includes the Tuzi integration, vendored core and build scripts.
Node runtime sources, version, official archive checksum and binary checksum
are identified in claude-local-runtime/provenance.json; its license is included.

Claude Desktop itself is not included in this package. Install it separately
from the official publisher. This integration does not grant an official
Claude subscription or change the terms of the configured model provider.

This is an unsigned testing candidate, not a production updater release.
